rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something frightening or threatening.

example.english: The monsters in that movie are really menacing.
example.traditional: 嗰套戲啲怪物真係好嚇人。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 di1 gwaai3 mat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this especially for a hostile, violent-looking person, expression, or atmosphere.

example.english: When he walked in, he looked really menacing.
example.traditional: 佢一行入嚟，個樣好有殺氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hang4 jap6 lei4 go3 joeng2 hou2 jau5 saat3 hei3

rows.note: Use this when explicitly stressing that something poses a threat or danger.

example.english: This virus is highly menacing to public health.
example.traditional: 呢種病毒對公共衞生有好大威脅性。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 beng6 duk6 deoi3 gung1 gung6 wai6 sang1 jau5 hou2 daai6 wai1 hip3 sing3
